tooling_notes.command_bridge: mcp__exec-daemon__execute_command runs on the host. Use it for every gh call and for git fetch/push/ls-remote, because origin is an ssh remote (git@github.com:kaecyra/gobbler.git) and the container has no ssh transport.
tooling_notes.worktree_setup: worktree_setup_command is empty until w0-scaffold and w0-e2e-harness land. Then set it to go mod download plus npm ci and a Playwright browser install in e2e/.
tooling_notes.gates_before_w0: make check does not exist until the foundation track lands. W0 workers report which targets exist rather than claiming gates passed.
